scope: Three standalone website product-card packshots, not 12-frame galleries.

prompts.mojito-metallique:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE square 1:1 high-resolution website product packshot, a finished realistic commercial studio photograph, of only MOJITO METALLIQUE from the supplied actual product photos.
Input 1 shows three bottles: use ONLY the center MOJITO METALLIQUE bottle as exact physical identity authority. Input 2 shows six canisters: use ONLY the far-left yellow MOJITO METALLIQUE canister. Input 3 shows the matching bottle and opened canister at left, providing materials/proportions. Ignore all other scents in these references.
Composition: exactly one upright capped bottle in front-left and its one CLOSED yellow cylindrical canister beside and slightly behind it at right, both complete with generous margin, filling about 70% of square height. Original cylindrical clear glass bottle with thick base, tall glossy black cylindrical cap, narrow silver collar, golden-yellow liquid. Preserve dimensions and bottle/cap/label proportions from real photograph. Yellow canister with black top/bottom rims, sleeve join low on cylinder, pale ivory rectangular front label. Canister visibly taller and wider than capped bottle with realistic matching packaging scale, about 1.15 times bottle height. Front labels face camera squarely and are fully unobstructed.
Backdrop: solid warm soft cream #f4e3cb seamless background and same matte cream tabletop, no gradient color blocks, neutral-warm studio lighting with soft grounded shadow and clean glass highlights.
Both existing labels must read verbatim in authentic black serif type: two lines "MOJITO" / "METALLIQUE". Below retain authentic small original monogram, "PARFUM" and "LONDON" with fine horizontal strokes. Do not add separate logos or label text. Printed spelling is M E T A L L I Q U E. No invented label words, no badge, watermark, overlay headline, people, props, plinths, extra bottles or additional packages. Opaque background, photograph only.
